defs.def: happening now; of the present time 现时发生的；当前的；现在的

ex.s: Oaks and sweetgums, which currently account for a majority of the city’s trees, produce huge amounts of a chemical substance called isoprene.
ex.t: 橡树和枫香树目前占纽约市树木的大多数，它们会产生大量一种叫作异戊二烯的化学物质。

ex.s: Current students, teachers (including retired) and staff can request items through ILL.
ex.t: 40岁出头的一个夜晚，我梦见一个穿红衣的高大女人走近我，递给我一袋颜料，告诉我开始画画。

ex.s: Current condition of the plants.
ex.t: 植物当前的生长状况。

ex.s: As we soon come to learn from AI by Design AI is already super-smart and will become more capable, moving from the current generation of “narrow-AI” to Artificial General Intelligence.
ex.t: 正如我们很快就能从《设计人工智能》中了解到的那样，人工智能已经超级聪明，并且将变得更强大，从当前的“狭义人工智能”发展到通用人工智能。

ex.s: Campbell’s point is to wake up those responsible for AI—the technology companies and world leaders—so they are on the same page as all the experts currently developing it.
ex.t: 坎贝尔的目的是唤醒那些对人工智能负责的人——科技公司和世界领导人——让他们与目前开发人工智能的所有专家达成共识。

ex.s: compare the current models with the previous ones
ex.t: 将当前模型与以前的模型进行比较

ex.s: We are determined that our teacher training programs should ________ current developments in the field of education.
ex.t: 我们决心让教师培训项目能够____跟上教育领域的最新发展。

ex.s: Current policies facilitate future decision-making.
ex.t: 当前的政策有助于未来的决策制定。

ex.s: With help from Tesla, Westinghouse's firm developed a system using alternating current, which soon became the major forms of power delivery.
ex.t: 在Tesla的帮助下，Westinghouse的公司开发了一套使用交流电的系统，这很快成为主要的供电方式。

ex.s: Currently, about 35,000 works                   in over 300 rooms in the Louvre, and it would take a lifetime to see everything.
ex.t: 目前约有35,000件作品                   在卢浮宫的300多个房间中看完所有展品需要一生的时间。

ex.s: With the current footprint of humanity, “it seems that global collapse is certain to happen in some form, possibly within a decade, certainly within this century,” Johnson said in an email.
ex.t: 以目前人类的足迹来看"全球崩溃似乎必然会发生某种形式可能在未来十年内肯定在本世纪内，"约翰逊在一封电子邮件中说。

ex.s: Bring your medical history, including a list of your current medicines.
ex.src: 2020全国新高考II卷·Talking with your doctor
ex.t: 记下医生说的话可以帮助你记住重要信息。

ex.s: "As an airline, we're currently in the process of turning all our planes into electric airplanes,” says CEO Greg McDougall.
ex.t: "作为一家航空公司，我们目前正在将所有飞机改装为电动飞机，"首席执行官格雷格·麦克杜格尔说。

ex.s: The current challenges of life were predicted by the ancestors.
ex.t: 当前的生活挑战已被祖先预测。

ex.s: These developments are likely to make our current problems with robocalls much worse.
ex.t: 不幸的是，这些措施太少也太迟了。

ex.s: The model projects that currently blue areas with little phytoplankton could become even bluer.
ex.t: 变暖改变了海洋的关键特征，并可能影响浮游植物的生长，因为它们生长不仅需要阳光和二氧化碳，还需要营养物质。

ex.s: Their findings were published in Current Biology in 2017.
ex.t: 根据詹妮弗·德布吕恩的说法，下一步研究是什么？

ex.s: If current trends don’t bend, Russia’s population will be about the size of Yemen’s by the year 2050.
ex.t: 如果当前的趋势不改变，到2050年俄罗斯的人口规模可能只有也门那么大。

defs.def: being used by or accepted by most people 通用的；流通的；流行的

ex.s: The NBA originated with eleven teams, and currently consists of thirty teams; twenty-nine of these teams are located in the US, and one in Canada.
ex.t: NBA最初由11支球队组成，目前共有30支球队；其中29支位于美国，1支在加拿大。

ex.s: Of course, I would like to have more freedom with money and no doubt I will be getting a credit card at some point, but I currently don’t have a steady income, so getting a credit card might tempt me to spend more money than I have!
ex.t: 当然，我希望在花钱方面有更多的自由，毫无疑问，我会在某个时候拿到一张信用卡，但我目前没有稳定的收入，所以拿到信用卡可能会诱惑我花比拥有更多的钱！

ex.s: Inspired by dolphins, people have learnt how to send signals underwater, which is currently employed in tsunami early-warning systems.
ex.t: 受海豚的启发，人们学会了如何在水下发送信号，这目前已应用于海啸预警系统中。

ex.s: Current situation of economic development: Problems demanding prompt solutions: Potential for further development: 1 What could be done to help promote economic development.
ex.t: 经济发展现状：需要立即解决的问题；进一步发展的潜力：可以采取什么措施来促进经济发展？

ex.s: Currently, China operates the world’s largest and most powerful radio telescope, the FAST telescope, completed in 2016.
ex.t: 目前，中国运营着世界上最大、最强大的射电望远镜——FAST望远镜，于2016年完工。

defs.def: the movement of water in the sea or a river; the movement of air in a particular direction （海洋或江河的）水流，潮流；气流
the flow of electricity through a wire, etc. 电流
the fact of particular ideas, opinions or feelings being present in a group of people 思潮；潮流；趋向
